title: www.chasefarrant.com
description: A portfolio inside a browser-based Linux terminal, with a conventional Browse view.
highlights: Linux runs locally through v86, with xterm.js handling the terminal.
Project records supply both the guest files and the Browse view.
Eleventy builds the site; an AWS pipeline publishes static files to S3 and CloudFront.

title: Finishing an unfinished basement
description: Turning an unfinished basement into living space, from planning and framing to wiring and drywall.
highlights: Planned around the existing sump pump, radon system, and HVAC.
Ran coax and CAT6a to every wall and insulated with Rockwool.
Hung drywall with my brother; a contractor handled mudding and taping.

title: Cap To Talk
description: Caps Lock dictation for Linux/X11, with local transcription and optional cleanup before inserting text.
highlights: Hold Caps Lock to record, then insert the transcription into the original window.
Run OpenASR and optional Ollama cleanup locally, with a raw transcription mode.
Use personal vocabulary hints, a spelling glossary, and a setup health check.

title: Propertunity
description: Property listing history, maps, and investment comparisons in one application.
highlights: Keep listing history so changes can be compared over time.
Combine property locations with investment calculations.
Built with Python, React, PostGIS, and MapLibre.

title: Cold Digger
description: Offline disk-image recovery for crypto wallets, deleted files, browser history, and media.
highlights: Scan raw disk images locally without modifying the source.
Recover files and investigate wallet material with source locations and coverage records.
Resume scans and review results in searchable offline reports, a file explorer, and a media gallery.

title: Homelab
description: Home networking, compute, and storage with documented operations and recovery.
highlights: Build around OPNsense, Proxmox, TrueNAS, and Docker.
Document how networking, compute, and storage fit together.
Keep recovery procedures alongside the operating notes.

title: Catch Amy recordings
description: Recordings from Catch Amy, the band I played guitar in during college.
highlights: Songs written and recorded around 2012.
The recordings are closer to a demo tape than a finished studio album.
Listen through the Spotify artist page.
